title: Air Force hunts for Scientist X

tellings.quote: Two hours after the lecture ended, Air Force investigators had shown up and were questioning students for clues about Scientist X's identity.

plain: In 1950 an unnamed lecturer known as Scientist X gave a talk in Denver, Colorado, and two hours after it ended, Air Force investigators showed up and began questioning students for clues about who he was. Michels tells this himself, citing people named Hansen, Unger and George Kohler, in an episode about claims of a crashed craft and alien bodies. If true, it would show the Air Force taking the lecture seriously enough to hunt down its speaker.
